# Phase 2 sanitized provider fixtures

Captured2026-10-06 using configured credentials and the production allowlisted read clients. No credentials, signatures or request headers are retained. See docs/evidence/PHASE_2_BINANCE_READS.json, PHASE_2_MASSIVE_READS.json, PHASE_2_CANDLE_BOUNDS.json and PHASE_2_CANDLE_PAGE.json for sanitized runtime evidence; manifest.json hashes the resulting fixture bytes.

Binance rwa_tokens.json selects the two measured NVDA BSC rows from the catalog; rwa_catalog.json preserves the later full488-row catalog, including critical-schema mismatches for quarantine tests. token_search.json retains the first5 results. trades.json removes userAddress; public token contracts/transaction hashes remain provider-returned facts. JSON numeric money lexemes are parsed directly as Decimal and written as canonical strings; this preserves financial precision but is an intentional fixture type transformation, not a byte-identical raw-wire archive. Integer timestamps/counts remain integers. Candle rows preserve column order; bounded/page fixtures retain measured out-of-bound/inclusive-end behavior.

Massive successful public data includes945 minute bars,3 daily bars,2 initial news articles,24 upcoming holiday rows and2 records each for splits/dividends. next_url was removed from news/corporate-action fixtures to exclude query authentication. Snapshot and NBBO403 bodies were not retained. Synthetic quote/snapshot fixtures in tests verify normalization and delayed/unknown labels; they do not establish account access. Tests use synthetic keys, MockTransport, fixed clocks and temporary databases; they never load local credentials or contact providers.

Official contracts: https://web3.binance.com/en/dev-docs/catalog/web3-wallet/api/rest-api/rwa-data ; https://web3.binance.com/en/dev-docs/catalog/web3-wallet/api/rest-api/general-data ; https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/aggregates/custom-bars ; https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/news .
